reason: RuntimeError, in two independent stages, both recorded: (1) import chain needs progressively heavier deps not in this env (joblib, yacs installed cheaply; next was pytorch_lightning -- stopped there, disk-space-constrained env at 4.2GB free, not worth the install just to reach stage 2); (2) even with imports fixed, build_eloftr() would still hit "official EfficientLoFTR checkpoint not found -- upstream distributes weights via a Google Drive link in its README, not a scripted download" -- the real, unavoidable blocker regardless of dependency work. kornia.utils.grid API-move incompatibility (a genuine, separate finding) was fixed with a shim in matchers.py#build_eloftr, kept for whoever revisits this with the checkpoint fetched by hand.
